_comment: The text prompt each rig's motion was generated from, keyed by its file in resources/glbs/ (the paper teaser's own assets, compressed as unimate/'s): the Teaser Scene's seven rigs, copied from unimate/resources/prompts.json, which records where every line came from (_sources) and the house style. Read by js/viewer.js; the homepage thumbnail hides the chips.
quadruped_spot_arm-step_reach.glb: A quadruped robot steps forward and extends its arm.
go2-rear_up.glb: A quadruped robot rears up to greet.
g1-pick_up.glb: A humanoid robot picks up an object.
mixamo-high_kick.glb: A human performs a high kick.
